full_judgment:
Mr. Sharif Uddin Chaklader, J.: This appeal at the instance of plaintiff directed against judgment and order dated 25.03.2009 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka dismissing in Miscellaneous Case No.13 of 2009 filed under Order IX Rule 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure for re-admission of Money Suit No.23 of 2006 to its original file and number. 

 2. Mr. S. N. Goswami, learned Advocate, appearing for the plaintiff-appellant, submits that, the impugned judgment and order having not considered properly the deposition of PW.I who deposed in support of his application that when the suit was taken up for hearing he was prevented by sufficient cause and also the learned Judge did not at all consider the illness of the learned Advocate for the plaintiff. Learned Advocate further submits that the learned Judge in dismissing the Miscellaneous Case did not give any reason and dismissed the Miscellaneous Case as barred by one year 6 months without considering that plaintiff filed Money Suit No.23 of 2005 for realization of Tk. 13 crore from defendant-respondent so he cannot himself allowed the suit to be dismissed for default on his absence. Learned Advocate submits that it was held by the apex Court that in moving the Court under Order IX Rule 4 of the Code, rejection of the case on the ground of limitation is improper. 

 3. We have perused the application, the memorandum of appeal and impugned order. In the application it is stated that plaintiff was totally unaware about the order of dismissal on the ground that learned Advocate for the plaintiff was ill. The plaintiff's witness No. 1 stated he was ill and made the application for re-admission. In the case of Abdul Kader Mondal and others Vs. Shamsur Rahman Chowdhury alias Shamsur Rahman Saha 51 DLR (AD) 253 it is held that "The principle that substantial justice shall take preponderance over technical consideration should always be kept in view in deciding whether or not there is sufficient cause for the delay." In holding so the Appellate Division referred to the case reported in AIR 1964, 215 wherein Appellate Division seen that the appellant as plaintiff paid maximum Court fee. For the reason made in the application, we are of the view that the suit should be disposed of merit as it is involved huge amount of money. But with direction to the plaintiff appellant that he shall pay cost of Tk.5,000/- to the defendant-respondent within 30 days from the date of receiver of this order by the learned Judge failing which the appeal shall stand dismissed. 

 5. The impugned order dated 25.03.2009 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 515 Court, Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 13 of 2009 is set aside. Money Suit No.23 of 2006 is readmitted to its file and number. Learned Judge is directed to proceed with the suit in accordance with law,
